provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: Query.one requires exactly one row; Query.maybe permits zero or one. Both reject a second row, propagate fetch errors, and close an acquired cursor on all exits. all(max_rows) preserves order and rejects overflow without truncating; next returns stable absence at EOF and closes on EOF/errors. Explicit close is idempotent.
